output.summary: The evidence does not support programming as the main driver. Per-concert sales at the same venue are the same with or without post-1945 works (E7), and core subscribers who attend renew at a steady 85% (E5). Peers with no venue change fell a median 29% (E10), so the decline is not unusual. The venue move is the strongest mechanism. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first year, the low-usage subscriber group doubled, and the downtown cathedral sold about 48% more tickets (E4, E5, E11). Lapsed patrons mostly cite travel and parking (E12). Marketing effect is unknown because nothing is tracked. Non-renewal would forfeit the $400k per season Halvorsen grant, and dropping commissions would lose the $180k Arts Council grant, so both are harmful. Do the segmented analysis and the cathedral and shuttle pilot.
